name: Multilingual exclude
description: Excludes selected pages/routes from translation handling.
project_description:
Do you use translations? Have you ever had pages that you wish were in the default language only, such as the layout builder page, then you can use this module to easily add pages and routes that are to not be translated.

 Features 
 Add routes to the configuration to the module as well as selecting what theme to display the route with. Super easy to setup and use and now whatever language you select admin pages to be in, the routes in config will be in that language.
